page.notes: Doubtful word: "qvi le" in the line "ti,& aliorum, qui le Augustini", where the second word could be "se" or another short word; I have written it as printed-looking and marked the first letter with [?]. The catchword "us" completes "illius" from the last line. The ampersands are printed as "&" and the abbreviation "adeoq;" is kept as printed.
